# DropdownMenu

floating popup. Positioning and dismissal (outside click, Escape) are Base UI Menu's; the rows are the public Menu family (`MenuGroup`, `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem`, `CustomItem`, `Section`) so a dropdown's menu looks exactly like any other menu in the system.

**Import:** `import { DropdownMenu } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.stories.jsx` — Overview, Placements, Spacing, WithSections, Loading, EscapeCloses, MenuKeyboardNavigation, Interactive

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `trigger` | element (required) | — | The element that opens the menu. A `Button` with a chevron is the default pattern. |
| `children` | node | — | The menu's rows: `Section`, `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem`, `CustomItem`. |
| `isOpen` | bool | — | — |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | — |
| `onOpenChange` | func | — | — |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-start'` | — |
| `shouldFlip` | bool | `true` | Flips to the opposite side when there isn't room. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'cozy'` | `cozy` draws 40px rows (default), `compact` draws 32px. |
| `loading` | bool | `false` | Draws a spinner in place of the menu's rows while its options load. |
| `minWidth` | string | — | — |
| `maxHeight` | string | — | — |
| `container` | object | — | Where the menu portals to. Defaults to the page. |
| `testId` | string | — | — |
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
